companyAnnouncements: PURPOSE: HEMIS-back = MARKAZIY ministry server (vazirlik 1 deploy). old-hemis (CUBA Platform 7.3 — Java + Groovy, Haulmont) ning Spring Boot 4 + Java 25 ga qayta yozilishi va optimizatsiyasi (Java → Java modernizatsiya). Per-OTM deploy YO'Q.
MISSION: 230 OTM aggregation + klassifikator markaziy distribution + qoidalar joriy qilish (talaba kiritish/baho lock) + davlat integratsiya (MyGov, MSPD, BIMM, Tax, GUVD).
CLIENTS: vazirlik admin (web), 224 ta Univer Yii2 PHP per-OTM (api-legacy/api-university REST), davlat sistemalari (api-external S2S). hemis_NNN — Univer'larniki, BIZGA TEGISHLI EMAS.
SCALE: 230 OTM aggregation, ~1.15M students metadata, ~5K admin (markaziy). Har commit milliy infratuzilmaga ta'sir qiladi.
BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY MANDATORY: api-legacy must match old-hemis 1:1 (175/175 integration tests). Run hemis-tools/.../compare_endpoints.js before merging api-legacy changes.
Database changes ONLY via Liquibase migrations (V###/M###/S### naming) with mandatory rollback file. NEVER ALTER/DROP/RENAME hemishe_* legacy tables.
JPA entities: @Getter @Setter (NOT @Data — equals/hashCode triggers N+1). @ManyToOne defaults to EAGER — always specify fetch=FetchType.LAZY.
@Cacheable / @Transactional / @Async on private methods does NOT work (Spring AOP self-invocation). Make method public or move to a separate @Service bean.
BCrypt strength 12 minimum (OWASP 2025). Never log PII (pinfl, password, jwt) — mask first 8 chars + '****'.
Module boundary: api-legacy → hemishe_*/sec_* tables only; api-university/api-web → new schema (employee_job, users, h_*). Mixing causes split-brain bugs (ADR-0008).
Naming exceptions: PostgreSQL reserved words (`users`, `orders`, `groups`) — PLURAL. Otherwise — SINGULAR. Soft-delete tables — Partial UNIQUE (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL).
Status semantics: ADR `Accepted` = decision made (not necessarily implemented). Check `## Implementation` section for actual progress (✅ done / ⏳ pending).
